title: Plant Manager, Dutch Harbor
text:
**JOB TITLE: Plant Manager, Dutch Harbor**

**DEPARTMENT: Cesco Solutions**

**REPORTS TO: CCO, Cesco Solutions**

**STATUS: Full time, exempt**

**LOCATION: Dutch Harbor, AK**

**Travel required to Dutch Harbor, approximately 67% of the year in various intervals**

**SALARY: $130,000-$150,000 USD, + Dutch Harbor onsite pay and milestone bonus up to 50% of base salary**

**BENEFITS: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, optional FSA/HSA, 401k with 6% employer match, life and AD&D insurance, Employee Assistance Program, short & long term disability, tuition reimbursement, 8 weeks annual PTO**

**About Us:**

 

**Tidal Vision:**

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive and systemic environmental impact by making our biopolymer solutions cost competitive, more convenient, and better performing than the synthetic chemicals we displace. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We value open, direct communication and foster a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

 

**About Cesco Solutions**: 
Cesco Solutions is the leader in creating client value in liquid/solids industrial water and process applications. Specializing in industries such as food & beverage, paper process and high-organics wastewater overall, we focus on eliminating waste/sludge through reduction and upcycling, at the same time, reducing contamination of downstream biological systems so they run more effectively and efficiently.

As part of Tidal Vision, Cesco leverages chitosan-based chemistry as a sustainable resource recovery approach, to traditional synthetic and metal-based chemistry, to improve paper strength, waste clarification, reduce sludge, and enhance treatment efficiency. By combining advanced chemistry, application expertise, and operational support, Cesco helps facilities optimize wastewater performance, lower chemical consumption, and maintain regulatory compliance while advancing more sustainable treatment practices.

 

**About Tidal Vision’s Unique Work Culture:**

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Plant Manager to lead the operations of our seafood processing facility in Dutch Harbor, AK. This individual will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, including production, food safety, quality assurance, maintenance, staffing, inventory management, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with experience managing manufacturing or food processing operations, preferably within the seafood, meat, poultry, dairy, or other protein processing industries. This role requires a strong commitment to employee development, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and delivering high-quality products to customers.

**Travel required to Dutch Harbor approximately 67% of the year in various intervals, with Dutch Harbor onsite per day bonus pay. Food and lodging provided.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operations Leadership:**

* Direct and oversee all daily plant operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and customer commitments are achieved.

* Develop production schedules that maximize throughput, efficiency, and product quality while minimizing downtime and waste.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to safety, productivity, labor efficiency, yield, quality, and on-time delivery.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and reduce costs.

* Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, maintenance, quality, and sales teams to ensure seamless operations.

 

**Team Leadership:**

* Lead, coach, and develop hourly production employees.

* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and operational excellence.

* Conduct performance evaluations, succession planning, and leadership development activities.

* Recruit, train, and retain a high-performing workforce.

* Promote open communication and maintain positive employee relations.

 

**Food Safety & Quality:**

* Ensure compliance with all food safety and quality standards, including HACCP, FDA, USDA (where applicable), GMPs, SSOPs, and sanitation requirements.

* Support internal and external audits while maintaining regulatory compliance.

* Partner with Quality Assurance to investigate product issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

* Foster a culture where food safety and product quality are prioritized throughout the organization.

 

**Safety & Compliance:**

* Champion a strong workplace safety culture by ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety policies.

* Lead safety meetings, incident investigations, and corrective action initiatives.

* Maintain compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

 

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operating expenses.

* Monitor labor costs, production yields, inventory levels, and operating efficiencies.

* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through process optimization and waste reduction.

* Prepare operational reports and present plant performance to senior leadership.

 

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement:**

* Partner with maintenance teams to ensure equipment reliability and minimize downtime.

* Support preventive maintenance programs and capital improvement projects.

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, and operational excellence.

 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Food Science, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing or food processing leadership experience.

* Strong leadership, communication, and employee development skills.

* Experience managing production schedules, labor planning, inventory, and operational budgets.

* Knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, GMPs, sanitation programs, and quality systems.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in seafood, seafood processing, aquaculture, meat, poultry, dairy, or other protein processing operations.

* Experience with frozen, fresh, or value-added seafood products.

* Knowledge of seafood handling, cold chain management, and traceability requirements.

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to work in refrigerated, wet, and production environments.

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the facility.

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.

* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hairnets, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and waterproof gear.

* Willingness to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, or holidays as production demands require.

 

**Licensing & Special Requirements**

* Incumbent is subject to a background check.

 

*Tidal Vision provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

*The statements contained herein reflect general details as necessary to describe the principal functions of this job, the level of knowledge and skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility, but should not be considered an all-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work in other functional areas to cover absences or relief, to equalize peak work periods, or otherwise to balance the workload. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.*
